{{Quote|To finally, truly, cripple Riboga, you must do two things. He has invested heavily in a spice mining operation in the Kemix system. Find some way to destroy the production facility there and he is all but over.|Morgra, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
'''Morgra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who operated as a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After engaging in a dispute with the rival Hutt [[Riboga]], Morgra was exiled to the [[Gravane system/Legends|Gravane system]], where he established a power base for himself aboard the [[Space station/Legends|installation]] [[Gravane station]]. Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] met with Morgra, and he provided them with information regarding the location of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Haast Aath]], in return for the agents undertaking a [[Skirmish on Kemix|mission]] to destroy Riboga's [[Spice Mines of Kemix|spice extraction operation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kemix]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Agree to my deal and you will not only be destroying a threat to your home, not only rescuing these lizard people you talk of, not only that but you get wealth, prestige and the opportunity to save some little gurgling bluehaired babies from a horrible death in this infernal space station. What do you say?|Morgra, to the Heroes of Cularin|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
Morgra, known to [[Gender/Legends|his]] underlings by the title [[Magnificent Superior High Lord]], was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Morgra developed a [[Politics/Legends|political]] rivalry with the Hutt [[Riboga]], but he lacked the influence of his adversary, and Riboga poached Morgra's [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Haast Aath]], from his service and ultimately had Morgra placed into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in the [[Gravane system/Legends|Gravane system]]. Morgra was forced to dwell aboard the run-down [[Space station/Legends|installation]] [[Gravane station]], and under the terms of his banishment he was forced to [[Language/Legends|speak]] only in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], a restriction that was considered among Hutts to be a humiliation. In spite of his fall from grace, Morgra retained a large portion of his wealth, and he established a power base for himself on the station, operating from the disheveled [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], the [[Throne Room (Gravane station)|Throne Room]]. There, he was attended to by an entourage of lackeys and entertainers, and he hired the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Mygg Morb]] to serve as his attendant.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

Circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', [[For Every Action: Counterstrike|''Counterstrike'']] can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Riboga seized control of organized crime in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and had Haast Aath establish a slaving ring on the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. After Aath kidnapped a large number of native [[Tarasin]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a band of freelance agents&mdash;were tasked with rescuing the Tarasin, and they sought to track down the Zabrak. During the course of their investigations, the agents ventured to Gravane station to meet with Morgra, hoping to obtain information from the Hutt regarding the location to which Aath had taken the slaves.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

{{RPG|[[For Every Action: Counterstrike|''Counterstrike'']]}}
Morgra viewed the arrival of the agents as an opportunity to strike against Riboga, and he negotiated with the freelancers, offering to provide them with aid only on the condition that in return they shut down Riboga's [[Spice Mines of Kemix|spice-mining enterprise]] on the planet [[Kemix]] and humiliate his rival by destroying Riboga's newly-built [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], ''[[Rightful Dominion]]''. After the agents refused to accept his terms, Morgra revised his offer and claimed that if his rival was brought down he could restore himself to a position of power and use his resources to relocate the residents of Gravane station, which was at imminent risk of structural failure. Once an agreement had been reached, Morgra revealed to the agents that Aath would likely have taken the kidnapped Tarasin to the world [[Tharados]], and the agents subsequently [[Mission to Tharados|rescued]] the slaves and [[Skirmish on Kemix|sabotaged]] Riboga's operation on Kemix.<ref name="Counterstrike" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But to complete his humiliation you must also destroy his new ship, the ''Rightful Dominion''.|Morgra, instructing the Heroes of Cularin to humiliate Riboga|<ref name="Counterstrike" />}}
A skilled negotiator, Morgra was adept at making deals. The Hutt liked to be flattered and to be granted grandiose titles by those around him, yet he he gave the appearance of being oblivious to the efforts of his underlings to please him. Following his exile, Morgra found speaking Basic to be demeaning, and he became desperate to leave the Gravane [[Star system/Legends|system]], yet could not risk doing so while Riboga remained in a position of power. As a result, he sought to take revenge and to humiliate his rival by bringing about the destruction of Riboga's [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] concern.<ref name="Counterstrike" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morgra was created by [[Rob Edwards]] and made his only appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in [[For Every Action: Counterstrike|''Counterstrike'']], a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[For Every Action trilogy|''For Every Action'' trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the adventure, the player characters [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the Heroes of Cularin and have the opportunity to negotiate with Morgra, and only if the players reject his initial proposal does Morga offer to relocate the inhabitants of Gravane station. It is also possible for the player characters to refuse to deal with Morgra entirely and to reach no agreement with him.<ref name="Counterstrike" />
